newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end higher on technical buying.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end higher on technical buying.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended higher across the board on Tuesday, as technical buying from individual investors emerged after the market plunged on Monday, local traders said.
Prices ranged from 260 to 340 yen higher with benchmark July 1998 closing 260 yen higher at 12,990 yen per tonne.
Yen-based corn futures plunged on Monday, as the yen's rise against the dollar triggered heavy selling.
"Investors ignored the Chicago market's fall overnight, and continued buying on technical factors," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot July corn contract on the CBOT Project A overnight trading system stood at $2.40-1/4 per bushel at 0820 GMT, against $2.40-1/2 at Monday's close.
Spot July CBOT soybean contract was traded at $7.36 per bushel at 0820 GMT, against $7.32-3/4 at Monday's close.
